claim: nomic-embed-text-v2-moe is now available on the official Ollama library, making the prior report's top recommendation a drop-in experiment
qwen3-embedding is available on the official Ollama library and is a strong second candidate, notably for code retrieval (0.6B variant CPU-feasible)
pg_textsearch (Timescale/TigerData) is a Postgres-licensed BM25 extension released as an alternative to AGPL pg_search, claiming 4.7x query throughput over pg_search/Tantivy
pg_search is AGPL-licensed and its hosted availability is narrowing (removed for new Neon projects, March 2026), a distribution risk for recall's default lexical backend
claude-context (Zilliz) is recall's closest comparable and ships Merkle-tree incremental indexing; incremental sync is table stakes in this niche (Cursor uses the same technique)
recall's nightly CI never runs the golden-query harness despite CLAUDE.md declaring it 'the only number that matters' — the largest philosophy-vs-practice gap in the repo
status: supported (internal audit, single source, verifiable in-repo)

claim: rrf_k shipped default (10) silently diverges from the documented default (60) with no recorded rationale
chunk_code silently falls back to line-window chunking on any tree-sitter exception, contradicting the honest-degradation principle
The MCP server rebuilds DB connection and embedder client on every tool call; limit is unvalidated at the tool boundary
The eval harness reports point-estimate verdicts with no uncertainty quantification on a 40-query set
Core store code has good SQL parameterization discipline and the honest-degradation contract is genuinely implemented in the search path
